# EdSurge

> EdSurge is a comprehensive directory of K-12 schools, charter schools, and higher education institutions across the United States, featuring detailed profiles of schools and colleges with curriculum, technology integration, and student support information.

EdSurge maintains an extensive database of school and university profiles, covering charter schools, public school districts, community colleges, and major research universities. The platform serves as a resource for exploring educational institutions and their technology adoption, particularly in states like California, Colorado, and Texas.

## Key Topics

- Charter Schools
- K-12 Education
- Higher Education
- School Districts
- Community Colleges
- Blended Learning
- Hybrid Learning
- San Francisco
- California
- Colorado
- Texas
- School Profiles
- University Directories
- Institution Information
- EdTech Integration

- [Innovations High School](https://www.edsurge.com/schools/innovations-high-school): Innovations High School Salt Lake City profile with edtech directory
- [Ingenuity Prep](https://www.edsurge.com/schools/ingenuity-prep): Ingenuity Prep Washington DC charter school early childhood profile
- [Charles E. Smith Jewish Day School](https://www.edsurge.com/schools/charles-e-smith-jewish-day-school): Charles E. Smith Jewish Day School K-12 private school in Rockville, MD
